  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Signed-in admin only. Generates an age X25519 key and makes it the one
new backups are encrypted with. Older keys are kept, so this server can
still restore the backups made with them. The secret only leaves the
server through `GET /api/admin/backups/encryption/kit`.
